title: Smooth general member of an immersive linear system
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $Y$ a scheme smooth over $k$, $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module, $V$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space and $\psi:V\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$ a $k$-linear map. Assume that the image of $\psi$ generates $\mathcal L$ and that the associated morphism $Y\to\mathbf P(V)$ is an immersion. Then for general $v\in V\otimes_kk'$ the scheme $H_v$ is smooth over $k'$.
Here, for a $k$-vector space $V$ of dimension $r$ with a basis $v_1,\dots,v_r$, a property $P$ *holds for general* $v$ if there is a nonempty Zariski open $U\subseteq\mathbf A^r_k$ such that $P(v)$ holds for every field extension $k'/k$ and every $v=\sum_i a_iv_i\in V\otimes_kk'$ with $(a_1,\dots,a_r)\in U(k')$; and $H_v=Z(\psi(v))\subseteq Y_{k'}$ is the zero scheme of the section $\psi(v)=\sum_ia_i\psi(v_i)$ of $\mathcal L|_{Y_{k'}}$.
The scheme, smoothness, immersion, invertible-sheaf, generation, zero-scheme and base-change notions are those of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], [def-pc-zero-scheme] and [def-pc-base-change].
